translations.overview: A young woman develops a taste for human blood after experimental plastic surgery, and her victims turn into bloodthirsty zombies, leading into a city-wide epidemic.
translations.tagline: You can't trust your mother, your best friend, the neighbor next door…One minute they're perfectly normal, the next…RABID!
